subject.title: Gateway memory growth due to repeated file read errors

question: Should the remaining fix target the scheduled producer/prompt that emits bad paths, change generic read-tool behavior for directories and inferred memory paths, or wait for a live current-main reproduction before choosing either direction?
rationale: Source confirms partial failure shapes but not the scheduler producer or memory-retention mechanism, and broad read-tool fallback/listing behavior would change a model-facing contract.

options.title: Reproduce then fix producer
options.body: Require a current-main live scheduler/gateway repro, then fix the path-producing or retention path that causes repeated bad reads without broadening `read` semantics.

options.title: Accept read-tool semantic change
options.body: Allow `read` to infer/list special cases such as directories or daily-memory filenames, accepting a broader model-facing behavior change.

options.title: Treat only the bare-date slice
options.body: Let the open bare-date daily-memory PR proceed independently while this issue remains open for CORE.md, agent-tasks, and RSS-growth proof.

recommendation.title: Reproduce then fix producer
recommendation.body: Require a current-main live scheduler/gateway repro, then fix the path-producing or retention path that causes repeated bad reads without broadening `read` semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the best available routing owner from current-main blame for the read/gateway paths, though deeper non-shallow provenance should inform the final product decision.
